desc.zh: 从加法倒推到取余，证明边界上的整除检查。
desc.en: Reverse additions into remainders, then prove the boundary divisibility test.

complexity: O(1 + log(max(tx, ty))) time; O(1) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Forced reverse moves
concepts.description: Derive the unique positive predecessor from the larger coordinate.

concepts.name: Modulo and reachability boundary
concepts.description: Batch forced subtractions and finish using a divisible nonnegative difference.
